gates.rationale: Non-diagnostic positioning avoids medical-device class today; P6 carries the risk weighting
Applied LLM + RLHF, not wet-lab science

agency_play.build_scope: Partial functionality strictly below the clinical line: HIPAA-compliant administrative agents (scheduling, refill logistics, prep instructions) on FM APIs with BAAs and human escalation - Hippocratic's operational periphery without patient-clinical judgment.
agency_play.packaging: Fixed-scope 'Front-Office Agent' pilot per specialty; compliance-evidence pack add-on; managed retainer with audit logs.
agency_play.pricing: Pilot $40-80k; retainer $5-10k/mo; refuse any diagnostic/triage scope.
agency_play.first_clients: Mid-size multi-site clinics and dental/derm groups with front-desk staffing shortages.
